audit_status.source_base: Hebrew Deuteronomy / Devarim Torah-guarding, Horeb revelation, anti-image, exile-return, and refuge-city discourse, draft aligned later
audit_status.review_note: First-pass draft reviewed for addition/subtraction warning, Baal Peor memory, wisdom among nations, Horeb without form, anti-idolatry, exile and return, Divine uniqueness, cities of refuge, and Torah introduction.

verses.restored: Now, Israel, listen to statutes and judgments I teach you to do, so you may live and enter and possess land YHWH Divine of your fathers is giving you.

familiar.text: Now therefore hearken, O Israel, unto the statutes and unto the judgments, which I teach you, for to do them, that ye may live, and go in and possess the land which the LORD God of your fathers giveth you.

modern.text: Hear now, O Israel, the statutes and ordinances I am teaching you to follow, so that you may live and may enter and take possession of the land that the LORD, the God of your fathers, is giving you.

original.text: וְעַתָּ֣ה יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל שְׁמַ֤ע אֶל הַֽחֻקִּים֙ וְאֶל הַמִּשְׁפָּטִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֧ר אָֽנֹכִ֛י מְלַמֵּ֥ד אֶתְכֶ֖ם לַעֲשׂ֑וֹת לְמַ֣עַן תִּֽחְי֗וּ וּבָאתֶם֙ וִֽירִשְׁתֶּ֣ם אֶת הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֧ר יְהוָ֛ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י אֲבֹתֵיכֶ֖ם נֹתֵ֥ן לָכֶֽם

verses.restored: You shall not add to word I command you, and you shall not diminish from it, to keep commands of YHWH your Divine that I command you.

familiar.text: Ye shall not add unto the word which I command you, neither shall ye diminish ought from it, that ye may keep the commandments of the LORD your God which I command you.

modern.text: You must not add to or subtract from what I command you, so that you may keep the commandments of the LORD your God that I am giving you.

original.text: לֹ֣א תֹסִ֗פוּ עַל הַדָּבָר֙ אֲשֶׁ֤ר אָנֹכִי֙ מְצַוֶּ֣ה אֶתְכֶ֔ם וְלֹ֥א תִגְרְע֖וּ מִמֶּ֑נּוּ לִשְׁמֹ֗ר אֶת מִצְוֺת֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָנֹכִ֖י מְצַוֶּ֥ה אֶתְכֶֽם

verses.restored: Your eyes saw what YHWH did at Baal-peor, for every man who went after Baal-peor YHWH your Divine destroyed from your midst.

familiar.text: Your eyes have seen what the LORD did because of Baalpeor: for all the men that followed Baalpeor, the LORD thy God hath destroyed them from among you.

modern.text: Your eyes have seen what the LORD did at Baal-peor, for the LORD your God destroyed from among you all who followed Baal of Peor.

original.text: עֵֽינֵיכֶם֙ הָֽרֹאֹ֔ת אֵ֛ת אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה בְּבַ֣עַל פְּע֑וֹר כִּ֣י כָל הָאִ֗ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֤ר הָלַךְ֙ אַחֲרֵ֣י בַֽעַל פְּע֔וֹר הִשְׁמִיד֛וֹ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ מִקִּרְבֶּֽךָ

verses.restored: But you who clung to YHWH your Divine are all alive today.

familiar.text: But ye that did cleave unto the LORD your God are alive every one of you this day.

modern.text: But you who held fast to the LORD your God are alive to this day, every one of you.

original.text: וְאַתֶּם֙ הַדְּבֵקִ֔ים בַּיהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֑ם חַיִּ֥ים כֻּלְּכֶ֖ם הַיּֽוֹם

verses.restored: See, I have taught you statutes and judgments as YHWH my Divine commanded me, to do thus in midst of land where you are entering to possess it.

familiar.text: Behold, I have taught you statutes and judgments, even as the LORD my God commanded me, that ye should do so in the land whither ye go to possess it.

modern.text: See, I have taught you statutes and ordinances just as the LORD my God has commanded me, so that you may follow them in the land that you are about to enter and possess.

original.text: רְאֵ֣ה לִמַּ֣דְתִּי אֶתְכֶ֗ם חֻקִּים֙ וּמִשְׁפָּטִ֔ים כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוַּ֖נִי יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֑י לַעֲשׂ֣וֹת כֵּ֔ן בְּקֶ֣רֶב הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר אַתֶּ֛ם בָּאִ֥ים שָׁ֖מָּה לְרִשְׁתָּֽהּ

verses.restored: Keep and do them, for this is your wisdom and understanding before eyes of peoples who hear all these statutes and say, Surely this great nation is a wise and understanding people.

familiar.text: Keep therefore and do them; for this is your wisdom and your understanding in the sight of the nations, which shall hear all these statutes, and say, Surely this great nation is a wise and understanding people.

modern.text: Observe them carefully, for this will show your wisdom and understanding in the sight of the peoples, who will hear of all these statutes and say, “Surely this great nation is a wise and understanding people.”

original.text: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּם֮ וַעֲשִׂיתֶם֒ כִּ֣י הִ֤וא חָכְמַתְכֶם֙ וּבִ֣ינַתְכֶ֔ם לְעֵינֵ֖י הָעַמִּ֑ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִשְׁמְע֗וּן אֵ֚ת כָּל הַחֻקִּ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה וְאָמְר֗וּ רַ֚ק עַם חָכָ֣ם וְנָב֔וֹן הַגּ֥וֹי הַגָּד֖וֹל הַזֶּֽה

verses.restored: For what great nation has a divine near to it as YHWH our Divine whenever we call to him?

familiar.text: For what nation is there so great, who hath God so nigh unto them, as the LORD our God is in all things that we call upon him for?

modern.text: For what nation is great enough to have a god as near to them as the LORD our God is to us whenever we call on Him?

original.text: כִּ֚י מִי ג֣וֹי גָּד֔וֹל אֲשֶׁר ל֥וֹ אֱלֹהִ֖ים קְרֹבִ֣ים אֵלָ֑יו כַּיהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֔ינוּ בְּכָּל קָרְאֵ֖נוּ אֵלָֽיו

verses.restored: And what great nation has righteous statutes and judgments like all this Torah/instruction I set before you today?

familiar.text: And what nation is there so great, that hath statutes and judgments so righteous as all this law, which I set before you this day?

modern.text: And what nation is great enough to have righteous statutes and ordinances like this entire law I set before you today?

original.text: וּמִי֙ גּ֣וֹי גָּד֔וֹל אֲשֶׁר ל֛וֹ חֻקִּ֥ים וּמִשְׁפָּטִ֖ים צַדִּיקִ֑ם כְּכֹל֙ הַתּוֹרָ֣ה הַזֹּ֔את אֲשֶׁ֧ר אָנֹכִ֛י נֹתֵ֥ן לִפְנֵיכֶ֖ם הַיּֽוֹם

verses.restored: Only guard yourself and guard your soul/life greatly, lest you forget things your eyes saw and lest they depart from your heart all days of your life; make them known to your children and your children's children.

familiar.text: Only take heed to thyself, and keep thy soul diligently, lest thou forget the things which thine eyes have seen, and lest they depart from thy heart all the days of thy life: but teach them thy sons, and thy sons’ sons;

modern.text: Only be on your guard and diligently watch yourselves, so that you do not forget the things your eyes have seen, and so that they do not slip from your heart as long as you live. Teach them to your children and grandchildren.

original.text: רַ֡ק הִשָּׁ֣מֶר לְךָ֩ וּשְׁמֹ֨ר נַפְשְׁךָ֜ מְאֹ֗ד פֶּן תִּשְׁכַּ֨ח אֶת הַדְּבָרִ֜ים אֲשֶׁר רָא֣וּ עֵינֶ֗יךָ וּפֶן יָס֨וּרוּ֙ מִלְּבָ֣בְךָ֔ כֹּ֖ל יְמֵ֣י חַיֶּ֑יךָ וְהוֹדַעְתָּ֥ם לְבָנֶ֖יךָ וְלִבְנֵ֥י בָנֶֽיךָ

verses.restored: The day you stood before YHWH your Divine at Horeb, when YHWH said to me, Assemble people to me, and I will make them hear my words, that they may learn to fear/revere me all days they live on ground and may teach their children.

familiar.text: Specially the day that thou stoodest before the LORD thy God in Horeb, when the LORD said unto me, Gather me the people together, and I will make them hear my words, that they may learn to fear me all the days that they shall live upon the earth, and that they may teach their children.

modern.text: The day you stood before the LORD your God at Horeb, the LORD said to me, “Gather the people before Me to hear My words, so that they may learn to fear Me all the days they live on the earth, and that they may teach them to their children.”

original.text: י֗וֹם אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָמַ֜דְתָּ לִפְנֵ֨י יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶיךָ֮ בְּחֹרֵב֒ בֶּאֱמֹ֨ר יְהוָ֜ה אֵלַ֗י הַקְהֶל לִי֙ אֶת הָעָ֔ם וְאַשְׁמִעֵ֖ם אֶת דְּבָרָ֑י אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִלְמְד֜וּן לְיִרְאָ֣ה אֹתִ֗י כָּל הַיָּמִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֨ר הֵ֤ם חַיִּים֙ עַל הָ֣אֲדָמָ֔ה וְאֶת בְּנֵיהֶ֖ם יְלַמֵּדֽוּן

verses.restored: You drew near and stood below mountain, and mountain burned with fire to heart of heavens, darkness, cloud, and thick gloom.

familiar.text: And ye came near and stood under the mountain; and the mountain burned with fire unto the midst of heaven, with darkness, clouds, and thick darkness.

modern.text: You came near and stood at the base of the mountain, a mountain blazing with fire to the heavens, with black clouds and deep darkness.

original.text: וַתִּקְרְב֥וּן וַתַּֽעַמְד֖וּן תַּ֣חַת הָהָ֑ר וְהָהָ֞ר בֹּעֵ֤ר בָּאֵשׁ֙ עַד לֵ֣ב הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם חֹ֖שֶׁךְ עָנָ֥ן וַעֲרָפֶֽל

verses.restored: YHWH spoke to you from midst of fire; voice of words you heard, but form you did not see—only voice.

familiar.text: And the LORD spake unto you out of the midst of the fire: ye heard the voice of the words, but saw no similitude; only ye heard a voice.

modern.text: And the LORD spoke to you out of the fire. You heard the sound of the words, but saw no form; there was only a voice.

original.text: וַיְדַבֵּ֧ר יְהוָ֛ה אֲלֵיכֶ֖ם מִתּ֣וֹךְ הָאֵ֑שׁ ק֤וֹל דְּבָרִים֙ אַתֶּ֣ם שֹׁמְעִ֔ים וּתְמוּנָ֛ה אֵינְכֶ֥ם רֹאִ֖ים זוּלָתִ֥י קֽוֹל

verses.restored: He declared to you his covenant that he commanded you to do, ten words, and wrote them on two tablets of stone.

familiar.text: And he declared unto you his covenant, which he commanded you to perform, even ten commandments; and he wrote them upon two tables of stone.

modern.text: He declared to you His covenant, which He commanded you to follow—the Ten Commandments that He wrote on two tablets of stone.

original.text: וַיַּגֵּ֨ד לָכֶ֜ם אֶת בְּרִית֗וֹ אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֤ה אֶתְכֶם֙ לַעֲשׂ֔וֹת עֲשֶׂ֖רֶת הַדְּבָרִ֑ים וַֽיִּכְתְּבֵ֔ם עַל שְׁנֵ֖י לֻח֥וֹת אֲבָנִֽים

verses.restored: YHWH commanded me at that time to teach you statutes and judgments for you to do in land where you are crossing to possess it.

familiar.text: And the LORD commanded me at that time to teach you statutes and judgments, that ye might do them in the land whither ye go over to possess it.

modern.text: At that time the LORD commanded me to teach you the statutes and ordinances you are to follow in the land that you are crossing the Jordan to possess. A Warning against Idolatry (Deuteronomy 12:29–32; Ezekiel 6:1–7)

original.text: וְאֹתִ֞י צִוָּ֤ה יְהוָה֙ בָּעֵ֣ת הַהִ֔וא לְלַמֵּ֣ד אֶתְכֶ֔ם חֻקִּ֖ים וּמִשְׁפָּטִ֑ים לַעֲשֹׂתְכֶ֣ם אֹתָ֔ם בָּאָ֕רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר אַתֶּ֛ם עֹבְרִ֥ים שָׁ֖מָּה לְרִשְׁתָּֽהּ

verses.restored: Guard your souls/lives greatly, for you saw no form on day YHWH spoke to you at Horeb from midst of fire,

familiar.text: Take ye therefore good heed unto yourselves; for ye saw no manner of similitude on the day that the LORD spake unto you in Horeb out of the midst of the fire:

modern.text: So since you saw no form of any kind on the day the LORD spoke to you out of the fire at Horeb, be careful

original.text: וְנִשְׁמַרְתֶּ֥ם מְאֹ֖ד לְנַפְשֹׁתֵיכֶ֑ם כִּ֣י לֹ֤א רְאִיתֶם֙ כָּל תְּמוּנָ֔ה בְּי֗וֹם דִּבֶּ֨ר יְהוָ֧ה אֲלֵיכֶ֛ם בְּחֹרֵ֖ב מִתּ֥וֹךְ הָאֵֽשׁ

verses.restored: lest you act corruptly and make for yourselves carved image, form of any figure, likeness of male or female,

familiar.text: Lest ye corrupt yourselves, and make you a graven image, the similitude of any figure, the likeness of male or female,

modern.text: that you do not act corruptly and make an idol for yourselves of any form or shape, whether in the likeness of a male or female,

original.text: פֶּ֨ן תַּשְׁחִת֔וּן וַעֲשִׂיתֶ֥ם לָכֶ֛ם פֶּ֖סֶל תְּמוּנַ֣ת כָּל סָ֑מֶל תַּבְנִ֥ית זָכָ֖ר א֥וֹ נְקֵבָֽה

verses.restored: likeness of any beast on earth, likeness of any winged bird flying in heavens,

familiar.text: The likeness of any beast that is on the earth, the likeness of any winged fowl that flieth in the air,

modern.text: of any beast that is on the earth or bird that flies in the air,

original.text: תַּבְנִ֕ית כָּל בְּהֵמָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּאָ֑רֶץ תַּבְנִית֙ כָּל צִפּ֣וֹר כָּנָ֔ף אֲשֶׁ֥ר תָּע֖וּף בַּשָּׁמָֽיִם

verses.restored: likeness of anything creeping on ground, likeness of any fish in waters beneath earth;

familiar.text: The likeness of any thing that creepeth on the ground, the likeness of any fish that is in the waters beneath the earth:

modern.text: or of any creature that crawls on the ground or fish that is in the waters below.

original.text: תַּבְנִ֕ית כָּל רֹמֵ֖שׂ בָּאֲדָמָ֑ה תַּבְנִ֛ית כָּל דָּגָ֥ה אֲשֶׁר בַּמַּ֖יִם מִתַּ֥חַת לָאָֽרֶץ

verses.restored: and lest you lift eyes to heavens and see sun and moon and stars, all host of heavens, and be driven to bow to them and serve them, which YHWH your Divine apportioned to all peoples under all heavens.

familiar.text: And lest thou lift up thine eyes unto heaven, and when thou seest the sun, and the moon, and the stars, even all the host of heaven, shouldest be driven to worship them, and serve them, which the LORD thy God hath divided unto all nations under the whole heaven.

modern.text: When you look to the heavens and see the sun and moon and stars—all the host of heaven—do not be enticed to bow down and worship what the LORD your God has apportioned to all the nations under heaven.

original.text: וּפֶן תִּשָּׂ֨א עֵינֶ֜יךָ הַשָּׁמַ֗יְמָה וְֽ֠רָאִיתָ אֶת הַשֶּׁ֨מֶשׁ וְאֶת הַיָּרֵ֜חַ וְאֶת הַכּֽוֹכָבִ֗ים כֹּ֚ל צְבָ֣א הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם וְנִדַּחְתָּ֛ וְהִשְׁתַּחֲוִ֥יתָ לָהֶ֖ם וַעֲבַדְתָּ֑ם אֲשֶׁ֨ר חָלַ֜ק יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֨יךָ֙ אֹתָ֔ם לְכֹל֙ הָֽעַמִּ֔ים תַּ֖חַת כָּל הַשָּׁמָֽיִם

verses.restored: But you YHWH took and brought out from iron furnace, from Egypt, to be for him a people of inheritance, as this day.

familiar.text: But the LORD hath taken you, and brought you forth out of the iron furnace, even out of Egypt, to be unto him a people of inheritance, as ye are this day.

modern.text: Yet the LORD has taken you and brought you out of the iron furnace, out of Egypt, to be the people of His inheritance, as you are today.

original.text: וְאֶתְכֶם֙ לָקַ֣ח יְהוָ֔ה וַיּוֹצִ֥א אֶתְכֶ֛ם מִכּ֥וּר הַבַּרְזֶ֖ל מִמִּצְרָ֑יִם לִהְי֥וֹת ל֛וֹ לְעַ֥ם נַחֲלָ֖ה כַּיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה

verses.restored: YHWH was angry with me because of your words and swore I would not cross Jordan and not enter good land YHWH your Divine is giving you as inheritance.

familiar.text: Furthermore the LORD was angry with me for your sakes, and sware that I should not go over Jordan, and that I should not go in unto that good land, which the LORD thy God giveth thee for an inheritance:

modern.text: The LORD, however, was angry with me on account of you, and He swore that I would not cross the Jordan to enter the good land that the LORD your God is giving you as an inheritance.

original.text: וַֽיהוָ֥ה הִתְאַנֶּף בִּ֖י עַל דִּבְרֵיכֶ֑ם וַיִּשָּׁבַ֗ע לְבִלְתִּ֤י עָבְרִי֙ אֶת הַיַּרְדֵּ֔ן וּלְבִלְתִּי בֹא֙ אֶל הָאָ֣רֶץ הַטּוֹבָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ נֹתֵ֥ן לְךָ֖ נַחֲלָֽה

verses.restored: For I am dying in this land; I am not crossing Jordan. But you are crossing and shall possess this good land.

familiar.text: But I must die in this land, I must not go over Jordan: but ye shall go over, and possess that good land.

modern.text: For I will not be crossing the Jordan, because I must die in this land. But you shall cross over and take possession of that good land.

original.text: כִּ֣י אָנֹכִ֥י מֵת֙ בָּאָ֣רֶץ הַזֹּ֔את אֵינֶ֥נִּי עֹבֵ֖ר אֶת הַיַּרְדֵּ֑ן וְאַתֶּם֙ עֹֽבְרִ֔ים וִֽירִשְׁתֶּ֕ם אֶת הָאָ֥רֶץ הַטּוֹבָ֖ה הַזֹּֽאת

verses.restored: Guard yourselves lest you forget covenant of YHWH your Divine that he cut with you and make for yourselves carved image, likeness of anything YHWH your Divine commanded you against.

familiar.text: Take heed unto yourselves, lest ye forget the covenant of the LORD your God, which he made with you, and make you a graven image, or the likeness of any thing, which the LORD thy God hath forbidden thee.

modern.text: Be careful that you do not forget the covenant of the LORD your God that He made with you; do not make an idol for yourselves in the form of anything He has forbidden you.

original.text: הִשָּׁמְר֣וּ לָכֶ֗ם פֶּֽן תִּשְׁכְּחוּ֙ אֶת בְּרִ֤ית יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹ֣הֵיכֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר כָּרַ֖ת עִמָּכֶ֑ם וַעֲשִׂיתֶ֨ם לָכֶ֥ם פֶּ֨סֶל֙ תְּמ֣וּנַת כֹּ֔ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוְּךָ֖ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ

verses.restored: For YHWH your Divine is consuming fire, a jealous Divine.

familiar.text: For the LORD thy God is a consuming fire, even a jealous God.

modern.text: For the LORD your God is a consuming fire, a jealous God.

original.text: כִּ֚י יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ אֵ֥שׁ אֹכְלָ֖ה ה֑וּא אֵ֖ל קַנָּֽא

verses.restored: When you father children and children's children and grow old in land, and act corruptly and make carved image, form of anything, and do evil in eyes of YHWH your Divine to provoke him,

familiar.text: When thou shalt beget children, and children’s children, and ye shall have remained long in the land, and shall corrupt yourselves, and make a graven image, or the likeness of any thing, and shall do evil in the sight of the LORD thy God, to provoke him to anger:

modern.text: After you have children and grandchildren and you have been in the land a long time, if you then act corruptly and make an idol of any form—doing evil in the sight of the LORD your God and provoking Him to anger—

original.text: כִּֽי תוֹלִ֤יד בָּנִים֙ וּבְנֵ֣י בָנִ֔ים וְנוֹשַׁנְתֶּ֖ם בָּאָ֑רֶץ וְהִשְׁחַתֶּ֗ם וַעֲשִׂ֤יתֶם פֶּ֨סֶל֙ תְּמ֣וּנַת כֹּ֔ל וַעֲשִׂיתֶ֥ם הָרַ֛ע בְּעֵינֵ֥י יְהוָֽה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ לְהַכְעִיסֽוֹ

verses.restored: I call heavens and earth as witnesses against you today that you shall surely perish quickly from land you cross Jordan to possess; you shall not lengthen days upon it, but shall surely be destroyed.

familiar.text: I call heaven and earth to witness against you this day, that ye shall soon utterly perish from off the land whereunto ye go over Jordan to possess it; ye shall not prolong your days upon it, but shall utterly be destroyed.

modern.text: I call heaven and earth as witnesses against you this day that you will quickly perish from the land that you are crossing the Jordan to possess. You will not live long upon it, but will be utterly destroyed.

original.text: הַעִידֹתִי֩ בָכֶ֨ם הַיּ֜וֹם אֶת הַשָּׁמַ֣יִם וְאֶת הָאָ֗רֶץ כִּֽי אָבֹ֣ד תֹּאבֵדוּן֮ מַהֵר֒ מֵעַ֣ל הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֨ר אַתֶּ֜ם עֹבְרִ֧ים אֶת הַיַּרְדֵּ֛ן שָׁ֖מָּה לְרִשְׁתָּ֑הּ לֹֽא תַאֲרִיכֻ֤ן יָמִים֙ עָלֶ֔יהָ כִּ֥י הִשָּׁמֵ֖ד תִּשָּׁמֵדֽוּן

verses.restored: YHWH will scatter you among peoples, and you shall remain few in number among nations where YHWH drives you.

familiar.text: And the LORD shall scatter you among the nations, and ye shall be left few in number among the heathen, whither the LORD shall lead you.

modern.text: Then the LORD will scatter you among the peoples, and only a few of you will survive among the nations to which the LORD will drive you.

original.text: וְהֵפִ֧יץ יְהוָ֛ה אֶתְכֶ֖ם בָּעַמִּ֑ים וְנִשְׁאַרְתֶּם֙ מְתֵ֣י מִסְפָּ֔ר בַּגּוֹיִ֕ם אֲשֶׁ֨ר יְנַהֵ֧ג יְהוָ֛ה אֶתְכֶ֖ם שָֽׁמָּה

verses.restored: There you shall serve gods, work of human hands, wood and stone, which do not see or hear or eat or smell.

familiar.text: And there ye shall serve gods, the work of men’s hands, wood and stone, which neither see, nor hear, nor eat, nor smell.

modern.text: And there you will serve man-made gods of wood and stone, which cannot see or hear or eat or smell.

original.text: וַעֲבַדְתֶּם שָׁ֣ם אֱלֹהִ֔ים מַעֲשֵׂ֖ה יְדֵ֣י אָדָ֑ם עֵ֣ץ וָאֶ֔בֶן אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹֽא יִרְאוּן֙ וְלֹ֣א יִשְׁמְע֔וּן וְלֹ֥א יֹֽאכְל֖וּן וְלֹ֥א יְרִיחֻֽן

verses.restored: But from there you shall seek YHWH your Divine, and you shall find, when you seek him with all your heart and all your soul/life.

familiar.text: But if from thence thou shalt seek the LORD thy God, thou shalt find him, if thou seek him with all thy heart and with all thy soul.

modern.text: But if from there you will seek the LORD your God, you will find Him if you seek Him with all your heart and with all your soul.

original.text: וּבִקַּשְׁתֶּ֥ם מִשָּׁ֛ם אֶת יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ וּמָצָ֑אתָ כִּ֣י תִדְרְשֶׁ֔נּוּ בְּכָל לְבָבְךָ֖ וּבְכָל נַפְשֶֽׁךָ

verses.restored: In your distress, when all these words find you in latter days, you shall return to YHWH your Divine and listen to his voice.

familiar.text: When thou art in tribulation, and all these things are come upon thee, even in the latter days, if thou turn to the LORD thy God, and shalt be obedient unto his voice;

modern.text: When you are in distress and all these things have happened to you, then in later days you will return to the LORD your God and listen to His voice.

original.text: בַּצַּ֣ר לְךָ֔ וּמְצָא֕וּךָ כֹּ֖ל הַדְּבָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֑לֶּה בְּאַחֲרִית֙ הַיָּמִ֔ים וְשַׁבְתָּ֙ עַד יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ וְשָׁמַעְתָּ֖ בְּקֹלֽוֹ

verses.restored: For a compassionate Divine is YHWH your Divine; he will not abandon you or destroy you or forget covenant of your fathers that he swore to them.

familiar.text: (For the LORD thy God is a merciful God;) he will not forsake thee, neither destroy thee, nor forget the covenant of thy fathers which he sware unto them.

modern.text: For the LORD your God is a merciful God; He will not abandon you or destroy you or forget the covenant with your fathers, which He swore to them by oath. The LORD Alone Is God

original.text: כִּ֣י אֵ֤ל רַחוּם֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ לֹ֥א יַרְפְּךָ֖ וְלֹ֣א יַשְׁחִיתֶ֑ךָ וְלֹ֤א יִשְׁכַּח֙ אֶת בְּרִ֣ית אֲבֹתֶ֔יךָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר נִשְׁבַּ֖ע לָהֶֽם

verses.restored: For ask, please, of former days before you, from day Divine created humanity upon earth, and from one end of heavens to other: has there been anything like this great thing, or has anything like it been heard?

familiar.text: For ask now of the days that are past, which were before thee, since the day that God created man upon the earth, and ask from the one side of heaven unto the other, whether there hath been any such thing as this great thing is, or hath been heard like it?

modern.text: Indeed, ask now from one end of the heavens to the other about the days that long preceded you, from the day that God created man on earth: Has anything as great as this ever happened or been reported?

original.text: כִּ֣י שְׁאַל נָא֩ לְיָמִ֨ים רִֽאשֹׁנִ֜ים אֲשֶׁר הָי֣וּ לְפָנֶ֗יךָ לְמִן הַיּוֹם֙ אֲשֶׁר֩ בָּרָ֨א אֱלֹהִ֤ים אָדָם֙ עַל הָאָ֔רֶץ וּלְמִקְצֵ֥ה הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם וְעַד קְצֵ֣ה הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם הֲנִֽהְיָ֗ה כַּדָּבָ֤ר הַגָּדוֹל֙ הַזֶּ֔ה א֖וֹ הֲנִשְׁמַ֥ע כָּמֹֽהוּ

verses.restored: Has a people heard voice of Divine speaking from midst of fire as you heard, and lived?

familiar.text: Did ever people hear the voice of God speaking out of the midst of the fire, as thou hast heard, and live?

modern.text: Has a people ever heard the voice of God speaking out of the fire, as you have, and lived?

original.text: הֲשָׁ֣מַֽע עָם֩ ק֨וֹל אֱלֹהִ֜ים מְדַבֵּ֧ר מִתּוֹךְ הָאֵ֛שׁ כַּאֲשֶׁר שָׁמַ֥עְתָּ אַתָּ֖ה וַיֶּֽחִי

verses.restored: Or has a divine attempted to come take for itself a nation from midst of nation, by trials, signs, wonders, war, strong hand, outstretched arm, and great terrors, according to all YHWH your Divine did for you in Egypt before your eyes?

familiar.text: Or hath God assayed to go and take him a nation from the midst of another nation, by temptations, by signs, and by wonders, and by war, and by a mighty hand, and by a stretched out arm, and by great terrors, according to all that the LORD your God did for you in Egypt before your eyes?

modern.text: Or has any god tried to take as his own a nation out of another nation—by trials, signs, wonders, and war, by a strong hand and an outstretched arm, and by great terrors—as the LORD your God did for you in Egypt, before your eyes?

original.text: א֣וֹ הֲנִסָּ֣ה אֱלֹהִ֗ים לָ֠בוֹא לָקַ֨חַת ל֣וֹ גוֹי֮ מִקֶּ֣רֶב גּוֹי֒ בְּמַסֹּת֩ בְּאֹתֹ֨ת וּבְמוֹפְתִ֜ים וּבְמִלְחָמָ֗ה וּבְיָ֤ד חֲזָקָה֙ וּבִזְר֣וֹעַ נְטוּיָ֔ה וּבְמוֹרָאִ֖ים גְּדֹלִ֑ים כְּ֠כֹל אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂ֨ה לָכֶ֜ם יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֛ם בְּמִצְרַ֖יִם לְעֵינֶֽיךָ

verses.restored: You were shown to know that YHWH, he is Divine; there is none besides him.

familiar.text: Unto thee it was shewed, that thou mightest know that the LORD he is God; there is none else beside him.

modern.text: You were shown these things so that you would know that the LORD is God; there is no other besides Him.

original.text: אַתָּה֙ הָרְאֵ֣תָ לָדַ֔עַת כִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה ה֣וּא הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים אֵ֥ין ע֖וֹד מִלְבַדּֽוֹ

verses.restored: From heavens he made you hear his voice to discipline/instruct you, and upon earth he showed you his great fire, and his words you heard from midst of fire.

familiar.text: Out of heaven he made thee to hear his voice, that he might instruct thee: and upon earth he shewed thee his great fire; and thou heardest his words out of the midst of the fire.

modern.text: He let you hear His voice from heaven to discipline you, and on earth He showed you His great fire, and you heard His words out of the fire.

original.text: מִן הַשָּׁמַ֛יִם הִשְׁמִֽיעֲךָ֥ אֶת קֹל֖וֹ לְיַסְּרֶ֑ךָּ וְעַל הָאָ֗רֶץ הֶרְאֲךָ֙ אֶת אִשּׁ֣וֹ הַגְּדוֹלָ֔ה וּדְבָרָ֥יו שָׁמַ֖עְתָּ מִתּ֥וֹךְ הָאֵֽשׁ

verses.restored: Because he loved your fathers and chose their seed after them, he brought you out from Egypt by his presence and great power,

familiar.text: And because he loved thy fathers, therefore he chose their seed after them, and brought thee out in his sight with his mighty power out of Egypt;

modern.text: Because He loved your fathers, He chose their descendants after them and brought you out of Egypt by His presence and great power,

original.text: וְתַ֗חַת כִּ֤י אָהַב֙ אֶת אֲבֹתֶ֔יךָ וַיִּבְחַ֥ר בְּזַרְע֖וֹ אַחֲרָ֑יו וַיּוֹצִֽאֲךָ֧ בְּפָנָ֛יו בְּכֹח֥וֹ הַגָּדֹ֖ל מִמִּצְרָֽיִם

verses.restored: to dispossess nations greater and mightier than you from before you, to bring you in, to give you their land as inheritance, as this day.

familiar.text: To drive out nations from before thee greater and mightier than thou art, to bring thee in, to give thee their land for an inheritance, as it is this day.

modern.text: to drive out before you nations greater and mightier than you, and to bring you into their land and give it to you for your inheritance, as it is this day.

original.text: לְהוֹרִ֗ישׁ גּוֹיִ֛ם גְּדֹלִ֧ים וַעֲצֻמִ֛ים מִמְּךָ֖ מִפָּנֶ֑יךָ לַהֲבִֽיאֲךָ֗ לָֽתֶת לְךָ֧ אֶת אַרְצָ֛ם נַחֲלָ֖ה כַּיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה

verses.restored: Know today and return to your heart that YHWH, he is Divine in heavens above and upon earth beneath; there is none else.

familiar.text: Know therefore this day, and consider it in thine heart, that the LORD he is God in heaven above, and upon the earth beneath: there is none else.

modern.text: Know therefore this day and take to heart that the LORD is God in heaven above and on the earth below; there is no other.

original.text: וְיָדַעְתָּ֣ הַיּ֗וֹם וַהֲשֵׁבֹתָ֮ אֶל לְבָבֶךָ֒ כִּ֤י יְהוָה֙ ה֣וּא הָֽאֱלֹהִ֔ים בַּשָּׁמַ֣יִם מִמַּ֔עַל וְעַל הָאָ֖רֶץ מִתָּ֑חַת אֵ֖ין עֽוֹד

verses.restored: Keep his statutes and commands that I command you today, so it may be well with you and your children after you, and so you may lengthen days upon ground YHWH your Divine gives you all days.

familiar.text: Thou shalt keep therefore his statutes, and his commandments, which I command thee this day, that it may go well with thee, and with thy children after thee, and that thou mayest prolong thy days upon the earth, which the LORD thy God giveth thee, for ever.

modern.text: Keep His statutes and commandments, which I am giving you today, so that you and your children after you may prosper, and that you may live long in the land that the LORD your God is giving you for all time. Cities of Refuge (Numbers 35:9–34; Deuteronomy 19:1–14; Joshua 20:1–9)

original.text: וְשָׁמַרְתָּ֞ אֶת חֻקָּ֣יו וְאֶת מִצְוֺתָ֗יו אֲשֶׁ֨ר אָנֹכִ֤י מְצַוְּךָ֙ הַיּ֔וֹם אֲשֶׁר֙ יִיטַ֣ב לְךָ֔ וּלְבָנֶ֖יךָ אַחֲרֶ֑יךָ וּלְמַ֨עַן תַּאֲרִ֤יךְ יָמִים֙ עַל הַ֣אֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֶ֛יךָ נֹתֵ֥ן לְךָ֖ כָּל הַיָּמִֽים

verses.restored: Then Moses separated three cities across Jordan toward sunrise,

familiar.text: Then Moses severed three cities on this side Jordan toward the sunrising;

modern.text: Then Moses set aside three cities across the Jordan to the east

original.text: אָ֣ז יַבְדִּ֤יל מֹשֶׁה֙ שָׁלֹ֣שׁ עָרִ֔ים בְּעֵ֖בֶר הַיַּרְדֵּ֑ן מִזְרְחָ֖ה שָֽׁמֶשׁ

verses.restored: for manslayer to flee there who strikes his neighbor unintentionally and did not hate him in time past; he may flee to one of these cities and live:

familiar.text: That the slayer might flee thither, which should kill his neighbour unawares, and hated him not in times past; and that fleeing unto one of these cities he might live:

modern.text: to which a manslayer could flee after killing his neighbor unintentionally without prior malice. To save one’s own life, he could flee to one of these cities:

original.text: לָנֻ֨ס שָׁ֜מָּה רוֹצֵ֗חַ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִרְצַ֤ח אֶת רֵעֵ֨הוּ֙ בִּבְלִי דַ֔עַת וְה֛וּא לֹא שֹׂנֵ֥א ל֖וֹ מִתְּמ֣וֹל שִׁלְשׁ֑וֹם וְנָ֗ס אֶל אַחַ֛ת מִן הֶעָרִ֥ים הָאֵ֖ל וָחָֽי

verses.restored: Bezer in wilderness on plateau for Reubenites, Ramoth in Gilead for Gadites, and Golan in Bashan for Manassites.

familiar.text: Namely, Bezer in the wilderness, in the plain country, of the Reubenites; and Ramoth in Gilead, of the Gadites; and Golan in Bashan, of the Manassites.

modern.text: Bezer in the wilderness on the plateau belonging to the Reubenites, Ramoth in Gilead belonging to the Gadites, or Golan in Bashan belonging to the Manassites. Introduction to the Law

original.text: אֶת בֶּ֧צֶר בַּמִּדְבָּ֛ר בְּאֶ֥רֶץ הַמִּישֹׁ֖ר לָרֻֽאוּבֵנִ֑י וְאֶת רָאמֹ֤ת בַּגִּלְעָד֙ לַגָּדִ֔י וְאֶת גּוֹלָ֥ן בַּבָּשָׁ֖ן לַֽמְנַשִּֽׁי

verses.restored: This is Torah/instruction that Moses set before children of Israel.

familiar.text: And this is the law which Moses set before the children of Israel:

modern.text: This is the law that Moses set before the Israelites.

original.text: וְזֹ֖את הַתּוֹרָ֑ה אֲשֶׁר שָׂ֣ם מֹשֶׁ֔ה לִפְנֵ֖י בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל

verses.restored: These are testimonies and statutes and judgments Moses spoke to children of Israel when they came out from Egypt,

familiar.text: These are the testimonies, and the statutes, and the judgments, which Moses spake unto the children of Israel, after they came forth out of Egypt,

modern.text: These are the testimonies, statutes, and ordinances that Moses proclaimed to them after they had come out of Egypt,

original.text: אֵ֚לֶּה הָֽעֵדֹ֔ת וְהַֽחֻקִּ֖ים וְהַמִּשְׁפָּטִ֑ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבֶּ֤ר מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶל בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בְּצֵאתָ֖ם מִמִּצְרָֽיִם

verses.restored: across Jordan in valley opposite Beth-peor, in land of Sihon king of Amorite dwelling in Heshbon, whom Moses and children of Israel struck when they came out from Egypt.

familiar.text: On this side Jordan, in the valley over against Bethpeor, in the land of Sihon king of the Amorites, who dwelt at Heshbon, whom Moses and the children of Israel smote, after they were come forth out of Egypt:

modern.text: while they were in the valley across the Jordan facing Beth-peor in the land of Sihon king of the Amorites, who lived in Heshbon and was defeated by Moses and the Israelites after they had come out of Egypt.

original.text: בְּעֵ֨בֶר הַיַּרְדֵּ֜ן בַּגַּ֗יְא מ֚וּל בֵּ֣ית פְּע֔וֹר בְּאֶ֗רֶץ סִיחֹן֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ הָֽאֱמֹרִ֔י אֲשֶׁ֥ר יוֹשֵׁ֖ב בְּחֶשְׁבּ֑וֹן אֲשֶׁ֨ר הִכָּ֤ה מֹשֶׁה֙ וּבְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בְּצֵאתָ֖ם מִמִּצְרָֽיִם

verses.restored: They possessed his land and land of Og king of Bashan, two kings of Amorite across Jordan toward sunrise,

familiar.text: And they possessed his land, and the land of Og king of Bashan, two kings of the Amorites, which were on this side Jordan toward the sunrising;

modern.text: They took possession of the land belonging to Sihon and to Og king of Bashan—the two Amorite kings across the Jordan to the east—

original.text: וַיִּֽירְשׁ֨וּ אֶת אַרְצ֜וֹ וְאֶת אֶ֣רֶץ ע֣וֹג מֶֽלֶךְ הַבָּשָׁ֗ן שְׁנֵי֙ מַלְכֵ֣י הָֽאֱמֹרִ֔י אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּעֵ֣בֶר הַיַּרְדֵּ֑ן מִזְרַ֖ח שָֽׁמֶשׁ

verses.restored: from Aroer on edge of wadi Arnon to Mount Sion, that is Hermon,

familiar.text: From Aroer, which is by the bank of the river Arnon, even unto mount Sion, which is Hermon,

modern.text: extending from Aroer on the rim of the Arnon Valley as far as Mount Siyon (that is, Hermon),

original.text: מֵעֲרֹעֵ֞ר אֲשֶׁ֨ר עַל שְׂפַת נַ֧חַל אַרְנֹ֛ן וְעַד הַ֥ר שִׂיאֹ֖ן ה֥וּא חֶרְמֽוֹן

verses.restored: and all Arabah across Jordan eastward, as far as sea of Arabah below slopes of Pisgah.

familiar.text: And all the plain on this side Jordan eastward, even unto the sea of the plain, under the springs of Pisgah.

modern.text: including all the Arabah on the east side of the Jordan and as far as the Sea of the Arabah, below the slopes of Pisgah.

original.text: וְכָל הָ֨עֲרָבָ֜ה עֵ֤בֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן֙ מִזְרָ֔חָה וְעַ֖ד יָ֣ם הָעֲרָבָ֑ה תַּ֖חַת אַשְׁדֹּ֥ת הַפִּסְגָּֽה

translation_notes: Horeb revelation is emphatically a heard voice without visible form; anti-image language protects Divine transcendence but must not justify destruction of other people's art or sacred sites.
Israel's Torah is presented as wisdom visible to nations, not as permission for ethnic supremacy.
The exile warning ends in return, seeking, compassion, and covenant memory—not permanent rejection.
Claims of Divine uniqueness and Israel's election remain Jewish covenant language and must not be superseded by later communities.
Verse 38's dispossession language remains morally contested and cannot authorize modern territorial violence.
The cities of refuge insert life-preserving asylum into the chapter's covenant exhortation.
safety_note: Do not use Deuteronomy 4 to justify iconoclasm, forced conversion, antisemitism, supersessionism, colonial dispossession, or blaming exiled and traumatized peoples for their suffering. Center memory, compassionate return, Torah wisdom, and refuge from revenge.
